svg.title: Disney Plus ads three month window versus a full year
svg.desc: Disney Plus Standard With Ads at 8.99 dollars a month, prices as of 20 May 2026. Three months is 26.97 dollars. Twelve months is 107.88 dollars. The gap is 80.91 dollars before tax.
svg.text: One franchise window, then the card stops
Disney+ Standard With Ads, $8.99/month. Prices as of 20 May 2026. Before tax.
The gap is $80.91 before tax. A second kids logo all year is a second gap, not a rainy-day plan.
Standard and Premium cost more. Annual Disney+ is the wrong product for a three-month window.
Ottawa Public Library Kanopy Kids uses 0 tickets between paid months. Your library's cap can differ.
